description:
The Sanitas Vacuole Bikepacker Titanium is individually handcrafted using carefully selected oversized cold-worked 3/2.5 titanium tubing. Each frame is hand-built to the customer’s specifications, one by one in our Durango, Colorado, facility, to provide a ride that’s designed specifically for the customer’s riding style and needs in mind.

Designed with contemporary geometry that can be optimized for suspension or rigid forks, making it more capable on technical and fast-descending trails, all the while offering a fun and low-maintenance option for a wide range of trails.

Rider position and preference can be tailored through custom geometry, which is all done in-house. The Vacuole design has been optimized to provide ample tire clearance of 29 x 2.6”, so you get that smooth ride over all types of terrain. Internal cable and dropper cable routing through the front triangle is included, with cables run externally on the rear. With the ability to hand-select the components of your choice for your Vacuole frame, you can build the high-performing adventure bike of your dreams.

We can also provide plenty of optional mounts for frame bags, as well as fenders and rack mounts of your choosing. Inquire about how you would prefer to have your storage options built out, as we can quote accordingly.

The customization does not stop with your frame geometry or finish! Drivetrain and components are just as personal as your riding style! With the ability to hand-select the components of your choice, you have 100% say in building out the bike of your dreams. Complete bike builds are quoted upon request and individualized for each rider.
